up: List all distinct molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3751755. The document is stored in the docs table; molecules are linked to documents via compound_records. For each such molecule, provide its ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Sort the results by the molecule's ChEMBL identifier in ascending order. Include molecules even if some fields are missing.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3751755' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
